parameters.help_en: The site ID. Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html operation to obtain this ID
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en: The configuration ID. Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2866985.html operation to obtain this ID
parameters.help_zh: 配置的ConfigId，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2866985.html接口获取ConfigId
parameters.name: config_id

AdditionalCacheablePorts.description_en:
Additional ports on which caching is enabled.

Valid values: `8880`, `2052`, `2082`, `2086`, `2095`, `2053`, `2083`, `2087`, `2096`.

Separate multiple ports with commas
AdditionalCacheablePorts.description_zh:
在指定端口上开启缓存功能。
取值范围：8880、2052、2082、2086、2095、2053、2083、2087、2096
支持配置多个端口，不同端口间使用英文逗号分隔

BrowserCacheMode.description_en:
The browser cache mode. Valid values:

`no_cache`: Does not cache content.

`follow_origin`: Follows the origin cache policy.

`override_origin`: Overrides the origin cache policy
BrowserCacheMode.description_zh:
浏览器缓存模式。取值范围：
no_cache：不缓存。
follow_origin：遵循源站缓存策略。
override_origin：代替源站缓存策略

BrowserCacheTtl.description_en: The browser cache TTL, in seconds
BrowserCacheTtl.description_zh: 浏览器缓存过期时间，单位是秒

BypassCache.description_en:
Specifies whether to cache requests or bypass the cache. Valid values:

`cache_all`: Caches all requests.

`bypass_all`: Bypasses the cache for all requests
BypassCache.description_zh:
设置绕过缓存模式。取值范围：

cache_all：所有请求都缓存。
bypass_all：所有请求都绕过缓存

CacheDeceptionArmor.description_en:
Specifies whether to enable Cache Deception Armor. This feature helps mitigate web cache deception attacks by ensuring that only validated content is cached. Valid values:

`on`: Enabled.

`off`: Disabled
CacheDeceptionArmor.description_zh:
缓存欺骗防御。用于防御Web缓存欺骗攻击，通过校验的缓存内容才会被缓存下来。取值范围：

on：开启。
off：关闭

CacheReserveEligibility.description_en:
The eligibility for cache reserve. This controls whether a request bypasses the cache reserve node during an origin fetch. Valid values:

`bypass_cache_reserve`: The request bypasses the cache reserve.

`eligible_for_cache_reserve`: The request is eligible for cache reserve
CacheReserveEligibility.description_zh:
缓存保持资格。用于控制用户请求在回源的时候是否绕过缓存保持节点。取值范围：

bypass_cache_reserve：请求绕过缓存保持。
eligible_for_cache_reserve：符合缓存保持资格

CheckPresenceCookie.description_en:
Specifies cookies whose presence is checked when generating a cache key. If a specified cookie exists in the request, its name (case-insensitive) is added to the cache key. Separate multiple cookie names with spaces. Cookie names can contain the following characters:

Symbols: ! # $ % & ' * + - . ^ _ | \~

Digits: 0-9

Letters: lowercase English letters a-z
CheckPresenceCookie.description_zh:
生成缓存键的时候，检查指定的cookie是否存在，如果存在，则在缓存键中加入cookie名称（cookie名称不区分大小写）。支持输入多个cookie名称，多个值之间用空格分隔。cookie名称支持以下字符类型：
符号：! # $ % & ' * + - . ^ _ ` | ~
数字：0-9
字母：小写英文字母a-z

CheckPresenceHeader.description_en:
Specifies headers whose presence is checked when generating a cache key. If a specified header exists in the request, its name (case-insensitive) is added to the cache key. Separate multiple header names with spaces. Header names can contain the following characters:

Symbols: ! # $ % & ' * + - . ^ _ | \~

Digits: 0-9

Letters: lowercase English letters a-z
CheckPresenceHeader.description_zh:
生成缓存键的时候，检查指定的标头是否存在，如果存在，则在缓存键中加入标头名称（标头名称不区分大小写）。支持输入多个标头名称，多个值之间用空格分隔。标头名称支持以下字符类型：
符号：! # $ % & ' * + - . ^ _ ` | ~
数字：0-9
字母：小写英文字母a-z

ConfigType.description_en:
Indicates whether the response contains a global or a rule configuration. Valid values:

`global`: A global configuration.

`rule`: A rule configuration
ConfigType.description_zh:
配置类型，可以根据此参数查全局配置或者规则配置，取值范围：
global：查询全局配置；
rule：查询规则配置；

EdgeCacheMode.description_en:
The edge cache mode. Valid values:

`follow_origin`: Uses the origin server's cache policy. If none is provided, the default policy applies.

`no_cache`: Does not cache content.

`override_origin`: Overrides the origin cache policy.

`follow_origin_bypass`: Uses the origin server's cache policy. If none is provided, content is not cached.

`follow_origin_override`: Uses the origin server's cache policy. If none is provided, a custom cache TTL applies
EdgeCacheMode.description_zh:
节点缓存模式。取值范围：
follow_origin：遵循源站缓存策略（如果存在），否则使用默认缓存策略。
no_cache：不缓存。
override_origin：代替源站缓存策略。
follow_origin_bypass：遵循源站缓存策略（如果存在），否则不缓存。
follow_origin_override：遵循源站缓存策略（如果存在），否则使用自定义缓存TTL

EdgeCacheTtl.description_en: The edge cache TTL, in seconds
EdgeCacheTtl.description_zh: 节点缓存过期时间，单位是秒

EdgeStatusCodeCacheTtl.description_en:
The status code cache TTL, in seconds.

Set the cache TTL for a specific status code. For example, `404=10` specifies that responses with a 404 status code are cached for 10 seconds.

Set the cache TTL for status code classes, such as 4xx and 5xx. For example, `4xx=10` specifies that all responses with a 4xx status code are cached for 10 seconds.

Separate multiple entries with commas
EdgeStatusCodeCacheTtl.description_zh:
状态码缓存过期时间，单位是秒。
支持对指定状态码设置缓存过期时间，例如：404=10，表示对404状态码缓存10秒。
支持对4xx、5xx系列状态码设置缓存过期时间，例如：4xx=10，表示对400系列的所有状态码都缓存10秒。
支持对多个状态码设置缓存过期时间，状态码之间用英文逗号分隔

IncludeCookie.description_en:
Specifies the cookies to include in the cache key. Both the cookie names (case-insensitive) and their values are added to the key. Separate multiple cookie names with spaces. Cookie names can contain the following characters:

Symbols: ! # $ % & ' * + - . ^ _ | \~

Digits: 0-9

Letters: lowercase English letters a-z
IncludeCookie.description_zh:
生成缓存键的时候，加入指定的cookie名称（cookie名称不区分大小写）及其值，多个值用空格分隔。cookie名称支持以下字符类型：
符号：! # $ % & ' * + - . ^ _ ` | ~
数字：0-9
字母：小写英文字母a-z

IncludeHeader.description_en:
Specifies the headers to include in the cache key. Both the header names (case-insensitive) and their values are added to the key. Separate multiple header names with spaces. Header names can contain the following characters:

Symbols: ! # $ % & ' * + - . ^ _ | \~

Digits: 0-9

Letters: lowercase English letters a-z
IncludeHeader.description_zh:
生成缓存键的时候，加入指定的标头名称（标头名称不区分大小写）及其值，支持输入多个值，多个值之间用空格分隔。标头名称支持以下字符类型：
符号：! # $ % & ' * + - . ^ _ ` | ~
数字：0-9
字母：小写英文字母a-z

PostBodyCacheKey.description_en:
The mode for handling the body content when generating a cache key for POST requests. Valid values:

`md5`: Calculates the MD5 hash of the body content and adds the hash to the cache key.

`ignore`: Ignores the body content in the cache key
PostBodyCacheKey.description_zh:
Post缓存对缓存键的处理模式，支持以下两种模式：
md5：先对 Body 内容取 MD5，然后将 MD5 值加入缓存键
ignore：在缓存键中忽略 Body 内容
PostBodyCacheKey.title_en: Processing pattern for the cache key.

PostBodySizeLimit.description_en: The size limit (in KB) of the body content for POST caching. The value is an integer from 1 to 8. A null or empty value defaults to 8 KB
PostBodySizeLimit.description_zh: Post缓存对Body大小限制，值为数字，单位是KB，支持1～8KB大小的Body，值为空的时候，默认按8KB生效

PostCache.description_en: Specifies whether to enable the POST cache feature
PostCache.title_en: Toggle for the Post cache feature.

QueryString.description_en: Specifies the query strings to include in or exclude from the cache key. Separate multiple query strings with spaces
QueryString.description_zh: 生成缓存键的时候，需要保留或者删除的查询字符串，支持输入多个值，多个值之间用空格分隔

QueryStringMode.description_en:
The mode for handling query strings when generating a cache key. Valid values:

`ignore_all`: Ignores all query strings.

`exclude_query_string`: Excludes specified query strings.

`reserve_all`: Retains all query strings. This is the default value.

`include_query_string`: Includes specified query strings
QueryStringMode.description_zh:
在生成缓存键的时候，对查询字符串的处理模式。取值范围：

ignore_all：全部忽略。
exclude_query_string：删除指定查询字符串。
reserve_all：默认值，全部保留。
include_query_string：保留指定查询字符串

Rule.description_en:
The rule content, which is a conditional expression used to match user requests. This parameter applies only to rule configurations.

To match all incoming requests, use `true`.

To match specific requests, use a custom expression, such as `(http.host eq "video.example.com")`
Rule.description_zh:
规则内容，使用条件表达式来匹配用户请求。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。存在两种使用场景：
匹配所有传入请求：值设置为true
匹配指定请求：值设置为自定义表达式，例如：(http.host eq \"video.example.com\")

RuleEnable.description_en:
Specifies whether the rule is enabled. This parameter applies only to rule configurations. Valid values:

`on`: Enabled.

`off`: Disabled
RuleEnable.description_zh:
规则开关。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭

RuleName.description_en: The name of the rule. This parameter applies only to rule configurations
RuleName.description_zh: 规则名称。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数

Sequence.description_en: The rule execution order. A smaller value indicates a higher priority
Sequence.description_zh: 规则执行顺序。数值越小越优先执行

ServeStale.description_en:
Specifies whether to serve stale content. If enabled, edge nodes serve stale (expired) content from the cache when the origin server is unavailable. Valid values:

`on`: Enabled.

`off`: Disabled
ServeStale.description_zh:
响应过期缓存。开启之后，在源服务器不可用的情况下，节点依然可以使用已缓存的过期文件响应用户请求。取值范围：

on：开启。
off：关闭

SiteVersion.description_en: The version number of the site configuration. For sites with version management enabled, this indicates the configuration version. The default is 0
SiteVersion.description_zh: 站点配置的版本号。开启了配置版本管理的站点，可以通过该参数指定配置生效的站点版本，默认为版本0

SortQueryStringForCache.description_en:
Specifies whether to sort query strings before generating the cache key. Valid values:

`on`: Enabled.

`off`: Disabled
SortQueryStringForCache.description_zh:
查询字符串排序。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭

UserDeviceType.description_en:
Specifies whether to include the client's device type in the cache key. Valid values:

`on`: Enabled.

`off`: Disabled
UserDeviceType.description_zh:
生成缓存键的时候，加入客户端设备类型。取值范围：

on：开启。
off：关闭

UserGeo.description_en:
Specifies whether to include the client's geographic location in the cache key. Valid values:

`on`: Enabled.

`off`: Disabled
UserGeo.description_zh:
生成缓存键的时候，加入客户端地理位置。取值范围：

on：开启。
off：关闭

UserLanguage.description_en:
Specifies whether to include the client's language in the cache key. Valid values:

`on`: Enabled.

`off`: Disabled
UserLanguage.description_zh:
生成缓存键的时候，加入客户端语言类型。取值范围：

on：开启。
off：关闭
